dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Does time here pass the same way it does in the outside world? Not sure if I should be saying "good morning" or "good evening"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Don't worry — I think it's great.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I'm good at adapting to my environment. Teapot, water cup, wine barrel... I'd be fine in any container, really.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I'm very glad to hear that.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: And I'm very happy to be here. Thanks for having me.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: This place is so homey, and all the decor is so unique. I like everything about it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's nothing special. I just went with the flow.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I think that's a great way to live your life.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: It's the kind of mindset that makes it easier to move past things and overcome life's challenges.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Besides, it's your home. Your own comfort should be your first priority.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: The best homes are spaces where you can sprawl out and live the way you want. Just like my place — I pretty much leave my stuff wherever I want.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then, make yourself at home!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Okay! I basically already have.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: If that's what you want, I'd be happy to.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: You're better off choosing the topic, though. I usually only talk about a few things.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Like... growing vegetables?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Exactly.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Pretty amazing... It's like you know me already.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Doesn't make you feel uncomfortable, does it?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Oh, of course not.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: You're like a wild animal that seeks out human contact in a gentle way. No one's gonna turn that down.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: ...Sorry for comparing you to an animal. That came out wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: What I meant to say is, you're friendly and approachable. You make it easy for people to let their guard down.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Of course, I can tell your soul is more mature than your appearance suggests.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: There's a wealth of wisdom and experience behind your youthful appearance. If you were a fruit, you'd be... a tender one. The pick of the crop. Um...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: It's kind of hard to explain. All I'm trying to say is, I think you're great — the kind of person that everyone likes.

choices.text: It's the first time I've heard it put like that...

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Oh, did I say something weird?

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Sorry. That's kind of who I am.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: But, you don't seem to mind. So, I'll just keep being myself, okay?

choices.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: You should! You're in a good place. Some people grow older without the "growing wiser" part.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: ...I hope I don't turn out like that.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: When you think about it... At least I can grow my own vegetables and hunt, so I'll never go hungry, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: ...I can't think of anything. Is there anything you recommend?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about... something peaceful?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: In that case... maybe you'd like to try out Phlogiston Engraving?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: It sounds more serious than it is. Basically, it involves painting patterns which can be activated to generate different effects, using either Phlogiston or elemental energy.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: If we're not looking for a specific effect, we can make it even simpler by drawing random graffiti art and letting the rest happen naturally.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: For instance, drawing Paimon on the back of your hand might trigger extreme hunger for a little while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That checks out.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: It all comes down to the pattern itself and the formula of the paint.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about... something not peaceful at all?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: You mean some kind of sport or physical activity?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: We could race each other.

choices.text: And by that you mean... seeing who can run away the fastest?

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Never underestimate yourself.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: If you're not feeling confident enough, I can show you how to make graffiti smoke bombs. That way, it's a fair contest.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Oh... You're right.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: This place feels so much like home, I almost forgot I'm still a guest. Sorry about that.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: In that case, we'll have to settle for a good, old fashioned race. Fine by me, though — it's exercise either way.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Any other options?

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Sure. How about a combination of the two?

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: In other words, doing graffiti while racing.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Based on your reaction, you're hoping it was a joke, right?

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: So, uh... Yeah. It was a joke.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks for chatting with me. It's been a lot of fun.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Of course! And, anyway, I'm the one who should be thanking you.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: I don't get to visit friends' places very often, so I really appreciate you inviting me here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're welcome! Feel free to stop by anytime.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Thank you! Next time, I'll even bring along my prized radish — it's a big one.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: ...Yes?

choices.text: But sounds like a tough clean-up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Ororon.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Good morning. I'm only up this early because I haven't actually gone to sleep yet.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: So, go do your thing. I'll get some rest in a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Ororon.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Good night. You headed to bed?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I feel pretty awake, actually. If this place wasn't so secure, I could help keep watch. Oh, well...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Huh? Paimon can do that too? Then, the next time we get a chance, Paimon and I can keep watch together.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: These furnishings take me right back to my childhood...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Like these tall things, for instance. I remember finding it really hard to climb up to the top.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: And then once you grow up, you practically have to bend double to see the things down low more clearly... Heh, you grow up just to bend back down.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: These plants are growing superbly. And you can tell they're in a great mood.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: You're really good at taking care of your friends.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Of course, if you ever find they get upset, just let me know. I'll be more than happy to come cheer them up for you.
